/* cppi::489557427466dd50ac98b2fd232adfeb79dfd63cbb64edf390adc4e63de4b66d */
WITH curr_exposure AS
            ( 
                    SELECT
             parent.party_name AS "party_name_parent",  
            parent.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_parent",  
            coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_parent",  
            parent.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_parent",  
            parent.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_parent",  
            child.party_name AS "party_name_child",  
                    child.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_child",  
            coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_child",  
            child.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_child",  
                    child.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_child",  
            SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND pos.days_to_maturity = 1 THEN fact.credit_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS "exposure_expiring",  
            SUM(  
                   CASE  
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND  
                   ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                   OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                   THEN fact.st_exposure
                   ELSE 0
                   END
            ) AS "st_exposure",
            child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "st_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                           OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           THEN fact.mt_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "mt_exposure",
            child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "mt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.lt_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                            END
                    ) AS "lt_exposure",
            child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "lt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.credit_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                           END
                    ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.repo_fi_limit AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "der_exposure",
            child.der_fi_limit AS "der_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.der_repo_fi_limit AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            child.isrc_total_fi_limit AS "isrc_total_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-05-30' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            child.smd_total_fi_limit AS smd_total_limit
            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
            INNER JOIN fact_cr_exposure fact
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and fact.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
            ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and parent.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id and pos.chron_id = fact.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country parent_country
            ON parent.domicile_country_code = parent_country.alpha_2_code and parent.chron_id = parent_country.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country child_country
            ON child.domicile_country_code = child_country.alpha_2_code and child_country.chron_id = child.chron_id
            WHERE
            child.business_date = '2025-05-30'
            AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
            AND
                    (
                            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR EXISTS
                                    (
                                            SELECT 1
                                            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                            WHERE
                                            sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.chron_id = child.chron_id
                           AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                    )
                )
            GROUP BY
            parent.party_name,
                    parent.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ),
                    parent.rtg_final,
                    parent.rtg_outlook,
                    child.party_name,
                    child.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
                    child.rtg_final,
                    child.rtg_outlook,
                    child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit,
                    child.repo_fi_limit,
                    child.der_fi_limit,
                    child.der_repo_fi_limit,
                    child.isrc_total_fi_limit,
                    child.smd_total_fi_limit
            ),
            child_level_exp_limits AS
            (
                    SELECT
            'N' AS "is_parent",
            party_name_child AS "entity_name",
                    party_name_parent AS "parent_name",
                    CASE
                           WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= MAX( st_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( der_exposure ) >= MAX( der_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) >= MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS "status",
                   country_code_child,
                    coalesce( rtg_final_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_final",
            coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_outlook",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( exposure_expiring ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "exposure_expiring",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "st_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "st_smd_threshold",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) , '-')
            AS "st_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "mt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "mt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "mt_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ), 2)  AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "lt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "lt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "lt_available",
                    /* Comment this out until GCM can handle these new fields after July 7, 2017 Abacus 3.1 release */
                   coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_cash_pb_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "der_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "der_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( der_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "der_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_der_repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "isrc_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "isrc_total_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "smd_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( smd_total_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "smd_total_available",
                    cppib_party_id_child,
                   cppib_party_id_parent
            FROM curr_exposure c
            GROUP BY
            party_name_child, party_name_parent, country_code_child, rtg_final_child, rtg_outlook_child,
    cppib_party_id_child, cppib_party_id_parent--, 'N', coalesce( rtg_final_child, '0' ), coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '0' )
            ),
            breaches_under_parents_tbl AS
            (
                    SELECT
            cppib_party_id,
                --MIN( status ) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY LENGTH( status ) DESC) AS status
               DENSE_RANK () OVER(ORDER BY LENGTH(status) DESC) as state, status
             --MIN(STATUS) as STATUS
            FROM
                    (
                            SELECT
                            cppib_party_id_parent AS "cppib_party_id",
                            CASE
                           WHEN
                           ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-')) and (CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL)))
                           OR ((NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-')) and (NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-')) and (CAST(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) >= CAST(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL)) )

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')

WITH holdings_view AS ( 
    SELECT 
        asset.business_date, 
        perf.InvestmentStructureLevel2,

        asset.issuer_name, 
        holdings.market_value_pc_amount, 
        asset.country_of_exposure_code, 
        asset.gics_sector_name, 
        asset.gics_industry_group_name, 
        asset.gics_industry_name, 
        asset.gics_sub_industry_name, 
        asset.industry_sector_name, 
        asset.industry_group_name, 
        asset.industry_name, 
        asset.sub_industry_name
    FROM 
        asset.asset_instrument_classifications_latest_ex_epm AS asset
    JOIN 
        holdings.holding_valuation_ex_epm AS holdings

        asset.id_holding_decomposition = holdings.id_instrument

        asset.business_date = holdings.business_date
    JOIN 
        performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten as perf
    ON 
        holdings.id_model_portfolio = perf.model_portfolio
    AND 
        cast(perf.business_date as date) = holdings.business_date
    WHERE perf.investmentstructure  = 'F24_ISBU'
)
SELECT DISTINCT *
FROM holdings_view
WHERE InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Private Equity'
ORDER BY market_value_pc_amount DESC
LIMIT 3

	GROUP BY

	client_ip

select

    index_description,
    market_value_base,
    id_cppib_index,
    index_root,
    sector_code
from (
  select
    business_date,
    index_description,
    market_value_base,
    id_cppib_index,
    split_part(id_cppib_index, '_', 1) as index_root,
    split_part(replace(id_cppib_index, '_GR_USD_0_0', ''), '_', 2) as sector_code,
    rank() over (partition by feed_name order by feed_version desc) rank
  from market.cppib_index
  where business_date = (select max(business_date)
                         from market.cppib_index
                         where business_date <= date'2025-06-13'
                         and feed_name = 'sbei_idx_std'
                        )
  and (index_description like 'S&P%BMI%' or index_description like 'S&P%LARGEMIDCAP%')
  and id_cppib_index like '%_GR_USD_0_0'
  and currency_base = 'USD' and market_value_base is not null
  and feed_name = 'sbei_idx_std'
)
where rank = 1
and (sector_code is null or length(sector_code) = 2)
order by index_root, sector_code

/* cppi::32b3fb3360f084b4bdd4a1c069d46757e18af904e94e499519464a53aebcc009 */
SELECT
            from_currency as from_currency,
            to_currency as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-16')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-16')
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
        WHERE
            MainTable.business_date = Date('2025-06-16')
            and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
            and MainTable.mid_price != 0
            and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date,from_currency

/* QuickSight 9cab3d6f-8968-4e08-8b89-4f0ae95cc693 */
SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaptions|option|future|contract|deposit|paper|collateralized|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "holdings_search_holdings_lookthrough"

SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaptions|option|future|contract|deposit|paper|collateralized|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "holdings_search_holdings_lookthrough"

				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,

WITH
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
private_real_estate_model_portfolios AS ( -- "private" model portoflios that are actually part of listed portfolio 
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                          AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Private Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND mp.model_portfolio_id IN  ('RIALIA02', 'RIFLAM', 'RIESRKS', 'RIRELCP', 'RIUNITE')
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                          AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Infrastructure'                              AS investment_group,
            'Listed Infrastructure'                       AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Sustainable Energies'                        AS investment_group,
            'Listed Sustainable Energy Group'             AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT *
       FROM private_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios

WITH
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
private_real_estate_model_portfolios AS ( -- "private" model portoflios that are actually part of listed portfolio 
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                          AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Private Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND mp.model_portfolio_id IN  ('RIALIA02', 'RIFLAM', 'RIESRKS', 'RIRELCP', 'RIUNITE')
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Real Estate'                                 AS investment_group,
            'Listed Real Estate'                          AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Infrastructure'                              AS investment_group,
            'Listed Infrastructure'                       AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            'Real Assets'                                 AS investment_department,
            'Sustainable Energies'                        AS investment_group,
            'Listed Sustainable Energy Group'             AS business_unit,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT *
       FROM private_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
latest_version_of_abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id,
            t.abor_transaction_number,
            MAX(CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)) AS business_date
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag  = 'Active'
        AND t.elementary_transaction_code   IN ('Buy', 'Sell' ,'CapRed', 'BuyRaloc', 'SellRaloc')
        AND t.model_portfolio_id            IN (SELECT model_portfolio_id FROM listed_real_assets_model_portfolios)
   GROUP BY t.abor_transaction_number,
            t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id
),
abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_transaction_number,
            t.model_portfolio_id,
            t.abor_security_id,
            CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE)                                      AS period_closure_date,
            CAST(t.business_date AS DATE)                                            AS business_date,
            t.elementary_transaction_code,
            t.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            t.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('Buy', 'BuyRaloc')
                 THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency 
                 ELSE 0 
            END                                                                      AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('Sell', 'SellRaloc', 'CapRed')
                 THEN current_value_portfolio_currency 
                 ELSE 0 
            END                                                                      AS permanent_roc_historical
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 INNER JOIN latest_version_of_abor_transactions lt
         ON t.abor_security_id            = lt.abor_security_id
        AND t.model_portfolio_id          = lt.model_portfolio_id
        AND t.abor_transaction_number     = lt.abor_transaction_number
        AND CAST(t.business_date AS DATE) = lt.business_date
),
total_buys_and_sells AS (
     SELECT t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id,
            CAST(SUM(t.gross_invested_equity_historical) AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            CAST(SUM(t.permanent_roc_historical)         AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS permanent_roc_historical
       FROM abor_transactions t
   GROUP BY t.abor_security_id,
            t.model_portfolio_id
),
listed_deals AS (
     SELECT CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            h.abor_security_id                          AS investment_code,
            mp.model_portfolio_id                       AS model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            h.abor_security_name                        AS investment_name,
            h.abor_security_name                        AS investment_aggregate_name,
            h.abor_security_name                        AS allocation_name,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                AS cppib_ownership_percentage,
            CASE WHEN mp.business_unit = 'Listed Real Estate'
                 THEN 'Other'
                 ELSE 'Minority'
            END                                         AS investment_structure,
            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)                       AS investment_stage,
            s.country_of_exposure_name                  AS geographic_focus,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_3     AS sector_focus,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4     AS sub_sector_focus,
            mp.investment_department,
            mp.investment_group,
            mp.business_unit                            AS business_unit
       FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON h.model_portfolio_id          = mp.model_portfolio_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities s
         ON h.abor_security_id            = s.abor_security_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(s.business_date AS DATE)
  LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications asec
         ON s.cppib_sec_id                = CAST(asec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
        AND CAST(s.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(asec.business_date AS DATE)
)
  SELECT business_date                                                 AS "Buinsess Date",
         investment_code                                               AS "Investment Code",
         model_portfolio_name                                          AS "Herbi Name",
         investment_name                                               AS "Legal Entity Name",
         investment_aggregate_name                                     AS "Investment Name",
         allocation_name                                               AS "Allocation Name",
         COALESCE(CAST(cppib_ownership_percentage AS VARCHAR), 'N/A')  AS "CPPIB Percentage Ownership",
         investment_structure                                          AS "Investment Structure",
         COALESCE(investment_stage, 'N/A')                             AS "Investment Stage - Current",
         COALESCE(geographic_focus, 'N/A')                             AS "Geographic Focus",
         COALESCE(sector_focus, 'N/A')                                 AS "Sector",
         COALESCE(sub_sector_focus, 'N/A')                             AS "Subsector",
         investment_department                                         AS "Business Group",

/* cppi::74e8e6f7befd92937483edd40d1372f4c404f219ca398f187d976b413e69bd28 */
SELECT ctev.companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
            country, countrycode, city, region,
            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency,
            cf.period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency,
            investor_id, investor_name, ci.period_end_date as investment_period_end_date,
            percent_of_shares_outstanding as investor_percent_of_shares,
            rank_of_shares_held as investor_rank_of_shares_held
            FROM
            (-- Get company data +TEV
            SELECT companyid, companyname, business_description, yearfounded, webpage, ticker,
                            country, countrycode, city, region,
                            simpleindustryid, simpleindustry,
                            pricingdate, TEV, tev_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT c.companyid, c.companyname, bd.business_description,
                                c.yearfounded, c.webpage,
                                ti.tickersymbol||':'||e.exchange_symbol AS ticker,
                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_business_description bd ON
                                c.companyid = bd.company_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON
                                c.simpleindustryid = si.simple_industry_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqcountrygeo g ON c.countryid = g.country_id
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqMarketCap mc ON c.companyid = mc.companyid
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqSecurity s ON mc.companyId=s.companyId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqTradingItem ti ON s.securityId=ti.securityId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_exchange e ON e.exchange_id = ti.exchangeId
                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqCurrency cur ON ti.currencyId=cur.currencyId
                            WHERE s.primaryFlag=1
                                AND ti.primaryFlag=1
                                AND simpleindustryid IS NOT NULL
                                AND companystatustypeid IN (1,2) --1=Operating
                                                                -- 2=Operating Subsidiary
                                AND companytypeid IN (4) -- 4=Public
                                AND ((mc.TEV > 0 and cur.isocode is not null) OR mc.TEV IS NULL)
                                AND CAST(c.companyid AS VARCHAR(15)) LIKE '%2'
                )
            WHERE pricingdate=maxpricingdate
            ) AS ctev
            LEFT JOIN
            (-- Get LTM fundamentals for Public operating companies
            SELECT DISTINCT company_id,
                period_end_date, capiq_item, value_ltm, kpi_currency
            FROM
                (SELECT f.company_id,
                    max(fiscal_chain_id) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxfiscalchainid,
                    fiscal_chain_id,
                    max(period_end_date) over (PARTITION BY f.company_id) AS maxperiodenddate,
                    period_end_date,
                    CASE capiq_item_id
                        WHEN 112 THEN 'LTM_Revenue'
                        WHEN 4051 THEN 'LTM_EBITDA'
                    END AS capiq_item,
                    value_ltm, f.currency AS kpi_currency

            FROM

                                g.country, g.iso_country_2 AS countrycode, c.city, g.region,
                                c.simpleindustryid,
                                si.simple_industry_description AS simpleindustry,
                                mc.pricingdate,
                                max(pricingdate) over (PARTITION BY c.companyid) AS maxpricingdate,
                                mc.TEV, cur.isocode AS tev_currency
                            FROM capiq_company c

                                LEFT JOIN capiq_ciqsimpleindustry si ON

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
